title: BARMM chief lauds Marcos' affirmation of Bangsamoro autonomy
summary: COTABATO CITY— Bangsamoro Interim Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua on Thursday welcomed President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s affirmation of Bangsamoro autonomy, including its democratic…

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY— Bangsamoro Interim Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua on Thursday welcomed President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s affirmation of Bangsamoro autonomy, including its democratic institutions and political processes. “This principled position powerfully affirms the autonomy rightfully earned through decades of struggle, sacrifice, and unwavering commitment to peace,” Macacua said in a statement after the President congratulated the elected Members of Parliament and the creation of a coalition of 46 MPs in Davao City. “More importantly, it reinforces our collective responsibility to uphold, protect, and further strengthen this hard-won autonomy through the principles of Moral Governance,” Macacua added.
